title: Catch-and-Release Survival Care Log
dataSources: Fishing catches (`fishing:catch`), fishfinder sonar (`fishfinder:reading`), foraging finds (`foraging:find`), game-cam triggers (`gamecam:trigger`).
app: Outdoor logs — fishing apps (Fishbrain), sonar / fishfinder exports, game/trail cameras, and foraging journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=fishing:catch event=release
| stats avg(handling_time_s) as avg_handling, count as released by species
| eval good_practice=if(avg_handling<30,1,0)
| sort - released
description: Tracks how quickly you handle and release fish, encouraging the gentle practice that helps them survive.
value: Fast, careful handling dramatically improves catch-and-release survival; logging it keeps your practice honest.
implementation: Log release handling times into `index=personal`; review average handling per species.
visualization: Bar chart of average handling time by released species.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks how gently and quickly you release fish, helping them survive to be caught again.
